d: Saudi Arabia wants the world to see a new kingdom. But a disturbing case has raised questions about how much has really changed. A 40-year-old Kenyan domestic worker, Esther Wanja Muthoni, has reportedly been sentenced to 100 lashes for having a child outside marriage. She was also left without a job or shelter, and reportedly had no lawyer to represent her. Saudi Arabia announced reforms to its flogging laws in 2020. So how is this sentence possible? And where does the kingdom's promise of modernisation stand? Palki Sharma tells you.
